element.name: Canonical Name (Project official terminology) or Informal Name
element.refs: Uniform dictionary shape for type-specific or artifact-specific keys

join.provider: namespace address of the Providing Element
join.purpose: State the objective or standard this element or action fulfills.
join.function: Encounter Function of the PE within the RE context
join.ef: Function if it is the encounter of a functionality, or Encounter if it is the functionality of the encounter
join.relation: Active-voice descriptive fragment starting with a third-person singular present-tense verb ending in -s/-es; the implicit subject is the PE if ef is Function, or the RE if ef is Encounter
join.verb: The single root verb extracted from the relation (e.g., provides, tracks, restricts)
join.observation: Only high-value observations consisting of long-lasting, stable state for agent orientation
join.non_goal: high-value non-goals consisting of structural constraints
join.refs: Uniform dictionary shape for type-specific or artifact-specific keys
